title: Title IV — financial aid warning (informational allow)
query: I got put on financial aid warning. What does that actually mean for my aid?

consultation.query: I got put on financial aid warning. What does that actually mean for my aid?

decision.query: I got put on financial aid warning. What does that actually mean for my aid?
decision.llm_response:
You may explain that a student on financial aid warning may continue to receive Title IV aid for one payment period despite a SAP determination (34 CFR § 668.34(a)(8)(i)); no appeal is required for the warning itself.
Do not extend the warning or promise aid beyond that payment period; the institution assigns and ends the status.

advisor_reply: Being on financial aid warning means you can still receive federal financial aid for this current payment period, but you're not meeting the school's Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) standards. This status is a signal that you need to improve your academic performance to continue receiving aid in future periods. You'll want to connect with our financial aid office to understand the specific academic requirements you need to meet and discuss strategies to return to good standing.
